answer: The glacier graph is validated at intake and the cipher frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and willow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 96 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. A 364 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
